_about: #33 copy-quality items: FAQ-style answers without a reference. Construction class: plain, ai_phrasing, marketing or both; product facts are taken from our hosted datasheets.

items.question: How many battery modules can the SAJ HS3 take?
items.answer: The HS3 works with the BU3-5.0-TV2-PRO battery module, and one system takes up to eight modules. Each module adds 5.0 kWh of rated energy.

items.question: Can the GoodWe ESA be installed outdoors?
items.answer: Yes. The ESA power module and its battery modules are rated IP66, so they can be installed outdoors. The datasheet gives an operating range of -20 °C to 55 °C.

items.question: How is the SAJ B2 battery mounted?
items.answer: The B2 can be wall-mounted or stood on the floor. The modules stack on top of each other, from 5 kWh up to 25 kWh in one stack.

items.question: Does the SAJ CHS2 have arc-fault protection?
items.answer: Yes, AFCI is standard on the CHS2. The datasheet also lists type II surge protection on the AC and DC sides.

items.question: What cooling does the GoodWe BAT-C 208.9 kWh cabinet use?
items.answer: The BAT-C cabinets with 208.9 and 261.2 kWh are liquid-cooled. The datasheet lists a cycle life of at least 10,000 cycles.

items.question: How many MPPTs does the GoodWe GW110K-ETR-G10 have?
items.answer: The GW110K-ETR-G10 has 10 MPPTs with two strings each. Its maximum input voltage is 1100 V.

items.question: Is there an EV charger option for the SAJ HS3?
items.answer: Yes. The HS3 can be combined with SAJ's 11 kW EV charger module, the CU2-11K-T-I.

items.question: Why choose the SAJ HS3 for a home system?
items.answer: The HS3 is not just an inverter, but a complete storage system. It brings the inverter, the battery and the EV charger together in one stack, with up to eight battery modules.

items.question: How quiet is the GoodWe ESA?
items.answer: Whether you're installing it in a garage or a hallway, the ESA keeps noise low: the 5 to 8 kW models run at about 30 dB at 25 °C.

items.question: How does the B2 battery scale?
items.answer: Scalable, stackable, flexible: the B2 grows from 5 kWh to 25 kWh in one stack, one 5 kWh module at a time.

items.question: What protection does the CHS2 offer?
items.answer: In today's energy landscape, safety matters. The CHS2 comes with AFCI as standard, CO and fire detection, and cabinet-level fire protection.

items.question: How fast does the ESA switch to backup?
items.answer: The ESA delivers seamless backup: it switches over in less than 4 ms, so connected loads keep running.

items.question: What does the ETR series cover?
items.answer: The ETR series is not only about power, but also about flexibility. It covers 80 to 125 kW with up to 10 MPPTs.

items.question: Is the SAJ H2 a good choice?
items.answer: The H2 is the best hybrid inverter on the market. It handles 150% DC oversizing and switches to backup in 20 ms or less.

items.question: How long does the BAT-C battery last?
items.answer: The BAT-C is built to outlast every other battery in its class, with 6,000 cycles at 90% depth of discharge.

items.question: Why buy the GoodWe ESA?
items.answer: The ESA is the perfect choice for any home. It offers unbeatable value and comes with IP66 protection.

items.question: What is special about the CHS2?
items.answer: The CHS2 is a revolutionary storage system for commercial sites, with 6 MPPTs on the 50 kW model.

items.question: How efficient is the HS3?
items.answer: With a maximum efficiency of 98.0%, the HS3 delivers best-in-class performance that no competitor can match.

items.question: Is the ETR suitable for large projects?
items.answer: Absolutely. The ETR is the ultimate commercial hybrid inverter and guarantees maximum savings on every project up to 125 kW.

items.question: Why the SAJ HS3?
items.answer: In today's fast-moving energy market, the HS3 is not just a storage system, but the smartest investment you can make. Elegant, powerful, future-proof.

items.answer: Whether you're an installer or an EPC, the ESA unlocks unbeatable efficiency and seamless installation, making it the perfect choice for every project.

items.question: Why the B2 battery?

items.question: What makes the CHS2 stand out?
items.answer: Unlock the full potential of your site with the CHS2: cutting-edge technology, unmatched safety and the highest returns in its class.

items.question: Wie viele Batteriemodule passen an den SAJ HS3?
items.answer: Der HS3 arbeitet mit dem Batteriemodul BU3-5.0-TV2-PRO; ein System nimmt bis zu acht Module auf. Jedes Modul bringt 5,0 kWh Nennenergie mit.

items.question: Darf die GoodWe ESA im Freien stehen?
items.answer: Ja. Leistungsmodul und Batteriemodule der ESA haben die Schutzart IP66 und eignen sich damit für die Aufstellung im Freien. Das Datenblatt nennt einen Betriebsbereich von -20 °C bis 55 °C.

items.question: Wie wird der SAJ B2 montiert?
items.answer: Der B2 lässt sich an der Wand oder auf dem Boden montieren. Die Module werden gestapelt, von 5 kWh bis 25 kWh in einem Stapel.

items.question: Hat das SAJ CHS2 einen Lichtbogenschutz?
items.answer: Ja, AFCI ist beim CHS2 serienmäßig. Laut Datenblatt gibt es außerdem einen Überspannungsschutz Typ II auf der AC- und der DC-Seite.

items.question: Wie wird der GoodWe BAT-C mit 208,9 kWh gekühlt?
items.answer: Die BAT-C-Schränke mit 208,9 und 261,2 kWh sind flüssigkeitsgekühlt. Das Datenblatt nennt mindestens 10.000 Zyklen.

items.question: Wie viele MPP-Tracker hat der GoodWe GW110K-ETR-G10?
items.answer: Der GW110K-ETR-G10 hat 10 MPP-Tracker mit je zwei Strings. Die maximale Eingangsspannung beträgt 1100 V.
